시편 16:1.content: Michtam of David. Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

시편 16:2.content: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

시편 16:3.content: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

시편 16:4.content: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

시편 16:5.content: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

시편 16:6.content: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

시편 16:7.content: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

시편 16:8.content: I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

시편 16:9.content: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

시편 16:10.content: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

시편 16:11.content: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
